sentences: A randomized search algorithm may produce different valid solutions when run repeatedly on the same input.
The cited source raises the existence of pseudodeterministic polynomial-time algorithms for fundamental tasks of this kind.
Pseudodeterminism requires concentrating output on one preferred solution while retaining the advantages of randomness.
Such algorithms would make randomized computation more reproducible without necessarily making it fully deterministic.
Although the paper concerns bipartite matching in parallel complexity, the saved passage is broader and truncates its named examples, so it must not be treated as a new unresolved matching theorem.
